title: Mill Office Schedule: Minimum Run, Bin Capacity and Enrolment Charge Across the Feed and Animal Nutrition Programmes
content:
The smallest order the mill will run, the most the bin serving the programme will hold, and the one-off charge for enrolling the programme are set for each of the Feed and Animal Nutrition Programmes as follows.

| Programme | Smallest order the mill will run (tons) | Most the bin serving the programme will hold (tons) | One-off enrolment charge |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Bagged Feed Cash Account | 0.05 | 0.00 | $0.00 |
| Bulk Delivered Feed Account | 4.00 | 12.00 | $0.00 |
| Custom Mix Ration Program | 6.00 | 24.00 | $150.00 |
| Contracted Ingredient Program | 10.00 | 40.00 | $250.00 |
| Full Nutrition Partner Program | 12.00 | 60.00 | $600.00 |
| Medicated Feed VFD Program | 6.00 | 40.00 | $300.00 |

## The same figures put another way

The smallest run rises with the programme: five hundredths of a ton on the Bagged Feed Cash Account, against twelve tons on the Full Nutrition Partner Program. Bin capacity rises with it, from nothing recorded on the Bagged Feed Cash Account to sixty tons on the Full Nutrition Partner Program, with the Contracted Ingredient Program and the Medicated Feed VFD Program each at forty tons. Only three of the six carry an enrolment charge at all, and the highest of them is the six hundred dollars on the Full Nutrition Partner Program; the Bagged Feed Cash Account and the Bulk Delivered Feed Account are enrolled at no charge.

## Points of judgement on the figures

*Hypothetical.* An order of four tons on a Bulk Delivered Feed Account is exactly the smallest run the schedule sets for that programme, so it reaches the figure; an order of three and nine tenths tons on the same programme falls short of it.

*Hypothetical.* A Custom Mix Ration Program and a Medicated Feed VFD Program are each enrolled in the same month. The enrolment charges taken are one hundred and fifty dollars on the first and three hundred dollars on the second, since the charge is the one set against the programme enrolled and not a single figure for the mill.
